summary: Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASSED covering auth (register/login/me, 409 duplicate email, 401 bad password/token), office-location, biometrics (default state, enroll + 409 duplicate for face/fingerprint, delete, invalid type 400), attendance (requires enrolled biometric 400, outside geofence 400, full checkin+checkout happy path with distance <50m, 409 duplicate checkin, 400 checkout-before-checkin, 409 duplicate checkout, history filtered by month sorted desc, empty for other months). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen renders with blue theme, register -> auto-login works, Home shows geo-status-card/today-card/punch buttons, tab navigation to Riwayat & Setting works, Settings shows enroll-face/enroll-fingerprint/logout-button, logout returns to login. No console errors. Profile tab tap failed with get_by_text selector (multiple matches) - not a product bug.

minor.issue: check_in_time precision differs between POST response (full microseconds + '+00:00' tz) and subsequent GET (microseconds truncated to ms by Mongo, no tz suffix). Cosmetic but may confuse clients comparing strings. Consider normalizing via a datetime-aware serializer or returning ISO Z suffix consistently.

action_items: (Optional) Normalize datetime serialization so POST and GET return the exact same string (either both tz-aware ISO or both naive, matching Mongo's millisecond precision).
No functional fixes required - all specified features working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 480 lines - well-structured, within limit. No DRY violations, no hardcoded URLs, Mongo _id excluded via user_public/attendance_public serializers.
ObjectId handled safely with try/except in current_user.
Pydantic validation present on all request bodies; proper 400/401/404/409 status codes with Indonesian error messages.
WORK_START_HOUR logic: `late` variable is computed but unused; `status` only becomes 'terlambat' when now.hour > WORK_START_HOUR (never equals). Minor dead code / off-by-one for exact 9:00.
All interactive elements have testID. Good coverage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (biometrics/geolocation prompts cannot be executed on web preview as expected)

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_<uuid>@example.com users created across tests; seeded budi@example.com auto-created if missing. No cleanup performed (prefix TEST_ makes them easy to drop).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_absensi_api.py; conftest provides api/base_url/seed_login/fresh_user fixtures. BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Office geofence default: lat=-6.2, lng=106.816666, radius=200m. Biometric and geolocation (device APIs) can only be smoke-tested on web; real behavior requires native build. Login screen testIDs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, go-to-register. Home: geo-status-card, today-card, punch-fingerprint-button, punch-face-button. Settings: enroll-face, enroll-fingerprint, remove-{type}, logout-button.
